initial_scene: A Rubik's cube with green upper face and orange front face stands on the lowest wooden shelf. Both robot hands are open in the foreground; the right arm subsequently performs the transfer.

observed_sequence.action: Both hands are open; cube remains upright on the bottom shelf.
Right arm extends inward to the cube, positioning open fingers around its sides while the left hand remains open and uninvolved.
Right fingers close around the cube, with thumb beneath/front and other fingers over the upper/opposite side; cube is secured for lifting.
Right hand lifts the cube clear of the bottom shelf and raises it on the right side toward the top shelf, maintaining the grasp.
Right hand moves the cube inward over the top shelf and lowers it upright onto the surface.
Cube remains upright on the top shelf while right fingers spread/open above it; right hand stays close above the cube at the final frame.

arm_hand_roles.left: Open and largely stationary throughout; does not contact the cube, shelf, or right hand.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand transfer; no left-hand stabilization or hand-to-hand transfer.
